description: The source registry: for each supported source, its licence, how to fetch it, and how to map its raw response into ../schema/station-information.schema.json. This is JustGo's own authored normalization knowledge (MIT); the endpoint URLs are links, in the same category as the sourcePageURL values in the directory. It carries no operator content.

status.stable: Fully supported: a reviewed catalog exists in ../directory/directory.json and the fetch/map recipe below is verified end to end.
status.preview: The fetch/map recipe is verified live, but no reviewed catalog ships yet, so this source has no directory entries. Usable by a developer today; not yet wired into the app.

conventions.redistributable: false → you MUST fetch on the end-user's own device and must not cache-and-serve the operator's content; true → the licence permits redistribution with attribution.

access.kind.onDeviceFetch: Live request(s) to the operator, made from the end-user's device.
access.kind.bundledDataset: Static content ships in a redistributable data pack; only live fields (e.g. arrivals) are fetched.

conventions.serviceDay: Times past midnight belong to the service day: 00:21 is LATER than 23:39. Add 24h to any hour < 4 before comparing first/last trains.
conventions.mergeServices: Operators often return one record per service run, not per direction. Group by (line, direction) and keep the earliest firstTrain and latest lastTrain; never merge the two directions of a line.
conventions.placeholderHandling: A source's no-data token (see each source's `placeholders`) means unavailable: emit null for the field, do not copy the token through.

beijingSubwayOnline.attribution: Beijing Subway (Beijing Mass Transit Railway Operation Corp.)

rules.colorHex: lineColor is RRGGBB or #RRGGBB; normalise to #RRGGBB uppercase, else null.
rules.identity: Reject the response unless data.station.stationDeviceLocation equals the requested externalStationID and the station name matches the reviewed catalog.

lineColors.note: Array of {line_no, color}; one call covers the whole network.

firstLast.note: Array of rows for the whole line; filter by stat_id.

stationInfo.note: entrance_info, toilet_position and elevator are JSON strings that must be parsed again.

rules.keyNormalisation: func=fltime rows carry stat_id without leading zeros ("111"); the directory key is four digits ("0111"). Left-pad to four before matching.
quirks: no-data first/last trains come back as "--"; treat as null.
exit id may be a JSON number (陆家嘴) or a string (莘庄); coerce to string.

lineStation.note: The full network: businessObject[] lines, each with stations[] carrying stationShowCode, names and lineColor. One call yields every stationShowCode.

rules.request: POST with Content-Type application/json and body {} . No auth token is required (the client's token interceptor is disabled).
rules.colorHex: lineColor is 8-digit RRGGBBAA ("edcf3dff"); drop the alpha byte, prefix #, uppercase.
rules.coverage: Exit and facility endpoints (/station/getLetter, /getDevice, /getService) return null and are not populated; this source is lines-only.

access.note: Static station information (barrier-free facilities, from which exits and facility groups are derived) ships in the redistributable Hong Kong data pack under DATA.GOV.HK Terms of Use v1.2; attribution is mandatory. Only live next-train arrivals are fetched.

exits.from: bundled barrier-free facilities: accessible entrances and lift locations

facilityGroups.from: bundled barrier-free facility availability (lift, escalator, ramp, accessible restroom, tactile path, audio, visual)

rules.attribution: DATA.GOV.HK Terms of Use v1.2 require attribution and source identification wherever the data is shown.
